title: Package Custom Equipment Limit on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Surrender Settlements
content:
**Package benefit.** On a total-loss vehicle surrendered under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, documented custom equipment is paid, on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Premier, up to the option's custom equipment limit raised by 2000; on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Preferred, up to the option's custom equipment limit raised by 1000; on every other package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, up to the option's custom equipment limit.

The package is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record; the documented custom equipment value from the claim's total-loss declaration.

## Custom equipment limit by package and option (USD)

| Deductible option | Option limit | Cardinal Auto Premier | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Every other package |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 1000 | 3000 | 2000 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1000 | 3000 | 2000 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 1500 | 3500 | 2500 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 1500 | 3500 | 2500 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 2500 | 4500 | 3500 | 2500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 5000 | 7000 | 6000 | 5000 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical equipment values)

- Documented custom equipment 3200.00 on the $500 option, Cardinal Auto Premier policy: limit 3500, so 3200.00 is paid.
- The same equipment on a Cardinal Auto Preferred policy: limit 2500, so 2500.00 is paid.
- The same equipment on a Cardinal Auto Standard policy: limit 1500, so 1500.00 is paid.
